status: native startup unresolved; rejected configuration experiments; production playback unchanged
method: Same existing five-minute fixture and foreground interaction harness. Each invocation uses a fresh browser profile. Default and rate repeated, alternating in later pairs. One exploratory latency-hint trial. Diagnostic overrides only, not production options. Constructor and synchronous resume are timed separately from resume readiness and optional output switch.
limitations: Small local diagnostic sample, not randomized or a cross-device claim. Repository verification overlapped the second default/rate pair; no configuration speedup is claimed. No physical output route available. No physical sync, native-memory or manual/device acceptance. Empty system device list does not prove it caused the stall.
